The '''IR-15 Mobile Security Platform''' was a model of six-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]], a freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Shroud's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Stangg]] employed IR-15 [[Droid/Legends|droids]] among the forces that defended [[Sewage treatment plant (Quesh)|the Shroud's base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
IR-15 Mobile Security Platforms appear as enemies in the missions "A Secret Revealed" and "Scratch the Surface," which are the Republic and Imperial versions of a mission in the [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] mission in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
